why: SSOT 9.3.1 H2/H3. The repair channel's only egress is writer_repair_candidate.fetch_sources, which takes explicit URLs. The first completed note/ja investigation ran with no network and therefore named zero primary_sources, so a repair handed that verdict would fetch nothing. This registry maps a destination to documents that were actually retrieved, so resolution never depends on a model recalling a URL.
curation_rule: Every url below was fetched during curation through writer_repair_candidate.fetch_sources, which is the same guard the channel uses at run time: https only, no credentials in the URL, no host resolving into a private, loopback, link-local, reserved or multicast range, unauthenticated GET, no cookie jar. The recorded sha256 is the curation receipt proving the document was read, NOT a pin: publishers edit their terms, and a changed hash is expected, not a failure. An entry may only be added by fetching it and recording what came back.

note/ja.why: note rejected an article body with HTTP 422 {"error":{"code":"invalid","message":"本文に利用できない内容が含まれています。"}}. Deciding whether that is a content-contract violation requires note's own binding terms, which is where the 禁止事項 clause lives.

sources.note: The only error catalogue note publishes. Measured during curation to list exactly two articles, both about sign-up reCAPTCHA and payment, and none about a rejected article body. That absence is evidence: it is why the verdict must not conclude a content-contract violation from the 422 message alone.

rejected_candidates.reason: Returns HTTP 200 and is NOT note's guideline. It is a user profile page titled 「GuideLine@明日のその先へ｜note」 (143493 bytes). This is the exact trap a recalled URL falls into: plausible shape, successful fetch, wrong document. A 200 is evidence of reachability, never of identity.
Same user profile page as note.com/guideline (143359 bytes), reached through the note.jp alias.
note's Zendesk help-centre search API is not public; every query returned 404, so the loop cannot discover articles by search and must be handed curated URLs.
No sitemap is published, so there is no cheap enumeration path either.

known_absent: No note document found during curation defines the response body 「本文に利用できない内容が含まれています。」 or the HTTP 422 that carries it. Recorded as absent rather than approximated. A repair that needs it must report it missing in remaining_work, never substitute a nearby document.
